sect1.title: General condition
sect1.para: Below are the descriptions of various configuration tags used in the input file.

sect2.title: method
sect2.para: Description: CCE Methods to calculate the dynamics of the system.

sect2.title: quantity
sect2.para: Description: Quantity to calculate the dynamics of the system.

sect2.title: order
sect2.para: Description: Order of the CCE method.

sect2.title: bfield
sect2.para: Data Type: Float or Float List

sect2.title: nstate
sect2.para: Description: Number of state templates to be generated.

entry.para: No state template will be generated (Ensemble approach)
State template will be generated (Single-sample approach) Mean-field effect will be automatically added

sect2.title: seed
sect2.para: Description: Seed for random number generator. If you want to generate the same state templates, you should set the same seed value.

sect2.title: qubitfile
sect2.para: Description: File path of the qubit spatial configuration. This tag is required when you use the qubit configuration file. Also, this only supports for a single qubit system.

para.preformatted: example) 10.0 12.0 13.0 - x,y,z position of qubit in cartesian, angstrom

sect2.title: gyrofile
sect2.para: Description: File name including bath spin information, e.g. gyromagnetic ratio, spin number

para.preformatted: File format is the following : [Name] [SpinNumber] [Gyromagnetic ratio (rad/ms/G)]

sect2.title: bathfile
sect2.para: Description: File name of the bath spatial configuration.

para.preformatted: example) 1.0 0.0 0.0 0.0 - Total line number 1.0 2.0 3.0 13C - x,y,z in cartesian, angstrom 4.0 5.0 6.0 P1 - Spin name should be the same to the name in gyrofile

sect2.para: Data Type: String (File path) or String List

sect2.title: bathadjust
sect2.para: Description: Adjust the bath configuration. If you want to adjust the bath configuration, you can set the bathadjust value. Usually, this tag is required for multiple qubit calculation that wouldb have different bath configuration

sect2.title: avaaxfile
sect2.para: Description: File name of the bath pricipal axis configuration. This tag might require when you want to calculate paramagnetic (PM) defect bath. During PM defect calculation, if you don't give this file, the program will automatically generate the principal axis configuration.

para.preformatted: File format is the following : [Principal axis index]
example) 5.0 - The number of total line 1.0 - principal axis index 2.0 - : 3.0 3.0

sect2.title: statefile
sect2.para: Description: File name of the bath state template. This tag might require when you want to obtain the result for a certain set of initial bath state. If the file path of the statefile doesn't exist, the program will automatically generate the state template.

para.preformatted: example) 5.0 - The number of total line -0.5 - Spin sublevel when S=1/2 0.5 - : -0.5 -0.5

sect2.title: exstatefile
sect2.para: Description: File name of the additional bath spin state template. This tag might require when you want to calculate paramagnetic defect bath. Each bath state represent the additional bath spin state. If the file path of the exstatefile doesn't exist, the program will automatically generate the state template.

para.preformatted: example) 5.0 - The number of total line -1.0 - Spin sublevel when S=1 0.0 - : 1.0 -1.0

sect2.title: DefectTotSpin
sect2.para: Description: Total spin number of the qubit. (Required when you use Hyperfine tensor file obtained by QUANTUM ESPRESSO)

sect2.title: CorrTotSpin
sect2.para: Description: Spin number correction (Required when you use Hyperfine tensor file obtained by QUANTUM ESPRESSO)

sect2.title: hf_readmode
sect2.para: Description: Interaction tensor between qubit and bath spins can be determined by this option. If you want to use the hyperfine tensor obtained from DFT calculation, you should set this option.

sect2.title: hf_tensorfile
sect2.para: Description: File name of the hyperfine tensor. This tag is required when you use the hyperfine tensor obtained from DFT calculation.

para.preformatted:
File format is the following : Todo

sect2.title: hf_ignore_oor
sect2.para: Description: Even if the bath spin is within the specified range set in the hyperfine tensor, if the code cannot find a matching spin relative position and spin tensor, it may or may not raise an error depending on this option.

sect2.title: qd_readmode
sect2.para: Quadrupole interaction tensor of bath spins can be set by this option. If you want to use the Quadrupole tensor obtained from DFT calculation, you should set this option.

entry.para: Read quadrupole DFT file from qd_tensorfile
Read quadrupole DFT file from both qd_tensorfile and qd_tensorfile_woqubit cell_para is required (Strained structure)
Read quadrupole DFT file from both qd_tensorfile and qd_tensorfile_woqubit cell_para is required (Bubble type structure)

sect2.para: Description: File name of the quadrupole tensor. This tag is required when you use the quadrupole tensor obtained from DFT calculation.

sect2.para: Description: File name of the quadrupole tensor without qubit. This would be useful for coherence simultion in the strained or bubble structure. This tag is required when you use the quadrupole tensor obtained from DFT calculation.

sect2.para: Description: Lattice parameter of the strained or bubble structure. This tag is required when you use the quadrupole tensor obtained from DFT calculation.
